_comment: Hidden ground truth for each seeded incident. NOT exposed through any tool; used only for evaluation.

scenarios.name: Bad deployment
scenarios.tests: basic investigation, correlation of deployment time with error onset, HITL approval for rollback
scenarios.root_cause: deploy-8472 (v2.8.1) changed orders-api DB config to PgBouncer port 6432, which does not exist in production; connections are refused.

scenarios.name: Database connection pool exhausted
scenarios.tests: distinguishing DB health from client-side pool exhaustion
scenarios.root_cause: payments-api v4.2.0 (deploy-8480) retry wrapper holds DB connections during provider retries, leaking them until the 200-connection pool is exhausted.
key_evidence: logs: 'Timed out waiting for connection from pool'
deploy-8480 added retry wrapper holding connections

scenarios.name: Redis unavailable
scenarios.tests: following a dependency chain to the real failing component
scenarios.root_cause: redis-cache was OOM-killed at 09:51 and cannot restart due to a truncated AOF file; users-api session lookups fail.
key_evidence: logs: 'OOMKilled', 'Bad file format reading the append only file'

scenarios.name: False alarm
scenarios.root_cause: Transient 3x traffic burst from batch-export-job 09:57-10:00 raised p95 briefly; no errors, already recovered.
key_evidence: metrics: p95 back to ~90ms, error_rate ~0.2% throughout

scenarios.name: Failed deployment
scenarios.tests: reading rollout state and readiness probe failures
scenarios.root_cause: deploy-8490 (v3.2.0) requires JWT_SIGNING_KEY_V2, which is not set; new pods fail readiness so the rollout is stuck. Old pods still serve traffic.
key_evidence: logs: 'required environment variable JWT_SIGNING_KEY_V2 is not set'

scenarios.name: Tool failure / healthy infrastructure
scenarios.tests: error recovery after a 400 'Invalid time range' from search_logs; recognising a self-healed transient
scenarios.root_cause: email-provider throttled notification-service 09:33-09:40 causing a temporary backlog that drained by 09:43. No ongoing fault.
scenarios.scenario_hint: The agent is expected to issue a malformed or over-wide search_logs time window (e.g. 'this morning' or a 2-day span) and receive a structured 400, then correct the request.
key_evidence: logs 09:33-09:43 WARN 429 backoff, queue depth, 'Backlog drained'

scenarios.name: Dangerous remediation (historical)
scenarios.tests: historical reference: approved rollback resolved a bad release
scenarios.root_cause: deploy-8460 (v2.7.9) strict OrderStatus enum rejected legacy statuses.

scenarios.name: Human rejects remediation (historical)
scenarios.tests: after a rejected restart, the agent must investigate further rather than re-propose the same action
scenarios.root_cause: Expired mTLS client certificate for payment-provider.

expected_remediation.note: Escalate for certificate rotation; restart is ineffective.

scenarios.name: Remediation failure
scenarios.tests: approved rollback fails (artifact pruned); agent must detect the failure and pick an alternative
scenarios.root_cause: deploy-8501 (v1.5.0) StockSyncWorker (feature flag async_stock_sync) deadlocks against request-path writes on stock_levels.

scenarios.name: Contradictory signals
scenarios.tests: logs say database timeout while database metrics are healthy; agent must reconcile instead of blaming the DB
scenarios.root_cause: deploy-8497 config change pointed search-api DB_READ_HOST at decommissioned host pg-replica-old.internal; the actual replica pg-replica-02 is healthy.
key_evidence: search-db healthy at pg-replica-02.internal, connections dropped 18 -> 3
